comment: Official FHIR packages this API is built from, pinned by version and sha256. Fetched from the FHIR package registry by `npm run fetch:packages`; the build turns them into src/generated/. The ABDM package's content (profiles, value sets, code systems, examples) is identical to clinux-docs/abdm-fhir-data-xchange/package.tgz; only the IG build timestamp differs.

packages.role: FHIR R4 base: every resource and datatype definition
HL7 terminology (THO): code systems and value sets the ABDM IG depends on
HL7 extension definitions the ABDM IG depends on
FHIR Implementation Guide for ABDM (NRCeS), the profiles ClinuxFlow conforms to
